projectDescription: A non-custodial DeFi risk-tranching protocol that splits yield sources into Senior and Junior tranches, giving Senior depositors smart-contract-enforced downside coverage and Junior depositors higher yield for taking first-loss exposure.
keyFeatures: Risk tranching: splits yield sources into Senior (protected) and Junior (first-loss, higher yield) tranches
Adaptive Yield Distribution Model (YDM) that auto-adjusts yield split based on utilization
Smart-contract-enforced coverage minimums with per-market calibration
Observation Period to distinguish temporary drawdowns from real losses
Protected Exit mechanism allowing Seniors to exit when coverage is breached
Managed vaults (srRoyUSDC and roywstETH) curated by Dialectic
Multi-chain deployment on Ethereum and Avalanche
publicApiSurface: Senior Royco USDC vault (srRoyUSDC) — ERC-4626 token, USDC deposit
Royco ETH vault (roywstETH) — ERC-4626 token, wstETH deposit
